sermon.title: Proof of Bad Judgments
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In “Proof of Bad Judgments,” Pastor David G. Kincer compares America before and after the sexual revolution that began in 1960 and says the results prove it was a bad judgment. He says the groups that promoted it have not admitted it was wrong, and he calls for confession and repentance (1 John 1:9, Luke 13:3). He closes with a Bible solution drawn from 2 Peter 1: moral excellence, knowledge, self-control, patience, respect for God and brotherly love.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: the captions give “Gara” as one of the two diseases, read here as gonorrhea; the name of the 13-year-old boy he mentions is garbled in the captions and is shown as [unclear]. He names real people and groups (Matthew Shepard, Barack Obama, Planned Parenthood, the teachers unions, the Republican and Democratic parties, the Supreme Court, the American Humanist Association) and speaks about homosexuality, abortion, evolution, the media and a child’s death as his own views; these are kept as spoken. He says Matthew Shepard was killed in Texas; published reports place that killing in Wyoming. His statistics (for example over 30 STDs, $16 billion a year, more than 50% of Americans with an STD, 44% of children in one-parent homes, 85% of youth in prison from single-parent homes, 40% unplanned births, 45,000 military men raped in 30 years, 1.2 million abortions a year, 500 teachers a year) are given with the sources he names (the CDC, the Department of Veterans Affairs, USA Today 2012) and have not been checked here.

chunks.section_question: What is the sermon “Proof of Bad Judgments” about?
chunks.short_answer: He says we can make bad, better and best choices, and in this session he shows the proof of bad judgments by comparing life before and after the sexual revolution that started in 1960 when the pill was introduced.
chunks.text: We can make bad choices, we can make better choices than bad choices, and then we can make the best choices. In this session we’re going to be talking about the proof, and showing you the proof, of bad judgments. We’re going to take a look at the sexual revolution that started in 1960, when the pill was introduced, up to the present. We’re going to look at things, uh, before the sexual revolution, and then we’re going to look at things after the sexual revolution.

chunks.section_question: How many sexually transmitted diseases were there before and after the sexual revolution?
chunks.short_answer: He says there were only two before 1960 and that now there are over 30, costing Americans $16 billion a year to treat. He says the share of people who have had one went from less than 2% to greater than 50%, citing the Center for Disease Control.
chunks.text: Before the sexual re- revolution happened in 1960, there were only two sexually transmitted diseases. Uh, we call them STDs, and these two sexually transmitted diseases were gonorrhea and syphilis. After the sexual revolution, and progressively so, new types of sexually transmitted diseases came up on the scene, and now we have over 30 sexually transmitted diseases. It cost American $16 billion a year to treat them, and this is from the Center of Disease and Control. Before the sexual revolution there were less than 2% that had a sexually transmitted disease; now it is greater than 50% of Americans have had or have now a sexually transmitted disease, where six of them kill and four are incurable.

Now 44% live in a one-parent home, and these children have a high percent of behavioral disorders, such as 85% of youth in prison come from single-parent homes; 85% that have been behavioral disorders come from single-parent homes. Before the sexual revolution, 10% were unplanned births; now 40% are unplanned births, according again to the Center for Disease Control.

At the same time, a young kid aged 13 by the name of Jesse [unclear] was lured up into an apartment by two homosexuals, tied up, and raped until the boy died, and yet the media made no big fuss over that at all. chunks.section_question: What are the four heartbreaks he says science has exposed?
chunks.short_answer: He names evolution, abortion, the claim that homosexuals were born that way, and safe sex education. He says science has exposed the first three, yet humanists, the media and other groups still promote them.
chunks.text: Now, there are four heartbreaks that science has exposed, but humanists, the media and other groups still promote, even though they’ve been scientifically exposed as a lie. Number one is evolution. There is no missing link, part ape and part man; there is no present mutation; and the big bang, why did it happen only once, and where did the first matter come from? You see, there is no scientific evidence. The second one is abortion. Science has declared that the baby is a human at conception, with all the DNA to become a human being, and yet they still abort babies. The third heartbreak is homosexuals. They were not born that way. Science said there is no homo- homosexual gene; it is a choice. And the heartbreak is that both homosexuals and people are saying they cannot change.

chunks.section_question: Why does he say safe sex education failed?
chunks.short_answer: He points to STD rates, 1.2 million abortions a year and 40% unplanned births as proof that it “just promoted loose sexual activity.” He asks those who say science is the solution to admit the mistake and make changes that protect innocent children.
chunks.text: The fourth one that’s a heartbreak is this safe sex education that was promoted by Planned Parenthood and the teachers unions of America and so forth. And 50% of Americans having a sexually transmitted disease, 1.2 million abortions per year, unplanned, 40% kids are unplanned births, are the proof that safe sex education didn’t work; it just promoted loose sexual activity. The humanist and followers say science, not the Bible or God, is the solution for man. If the humanist and their followers really believe that, then I submit to them: why don’t we unite, admit that this was wrong, we made a mistake, and make changes that protect people and innocent children from harm?

All promoted and supported the sexual revolution. None have admitted it was a bad judgment. I have not heard anyone from these groups admitting they were wrong, their group was wrong, and asking America to forgive them.

chunks.section_question: What does it mean to repent?
chunks.short_answer: Quoting Luke 13:3, he says repent is to turn my thinking from bad, harmful thinking to good, right thinking, and to turn my bad behavior to right behavior. He says the Bible idea of hope and change includes repentance.
chunks.text: None of these groups are calling for a change. Yet in Luke 13:3 the Bible says, unless you repent you shall all likewise perish. Repent is to turn my thinking from bad thinking, harmful thinking, to good thinking, right thinking, and turn my bad behavior to right behavior. And I’ve heard no group. Obama talked about hope, change, but he never mentioned and admitted that these judgments back there were wrong and we need to repent, and asked America to forgive us. His ideal of hope and change was not the Bible ideal of hope and change. But we need to get back to the Bible idea, the Bible principle, of hope and expectation and change. And I’m going to present to you some principles that will bring a solution to this pollution of the sexual revolution.

chunks.section_question: What is the Bible solution to the sexual revolution?
chunks.short_answer: He proposes adding the pursuit of moral excellence to our faith, teaching Bible morals (including in public schools), requiring self-control over sexual desires, and using patience to wait and marry one man to one woman for life.
chunks.text: Propose solutions to the sexual revolution, and I submit to these groups, you need to listen and respond to the Bible solution to these things. Number one, we need to add the pursuit of moral excellence to our faith. Whether you have the faith of humanist, there is no God, you’re a Christian, there is a God, or whatever, you need to add the pursuit. We’re not there yet, but we need to say we need to pursue moral excellent, right behavior. Number two, we need to teach the citizens of America the knowledge of Bible moral. We need to get the Bible back into public schools, teaching the principles of moral character. Number three, we need to require people use self-control over sexual desires, and a penalty if they don’t. Number four, we need to use patience to wait and marry one man to one woman for life, and we need to wait pr- through premarital sex and this free sex ideal and sexual revolution, and wait and save sex for marriage.

chunks.section_question: How does Bible morality save lives?
chunks.short_answer: He says to respect God, who is love, and obey love’s moral laws, because love does no harm to his neighbor. His bottom line: “Bible morality saves lives,” saves medical cost, saves marriages and saves the future of innocent children.
chunks.text: Number five, we need to teach respect for God, and remember God is love, and obey love’s moral laws. Whether you believe in God or not, you must believe in love, and love does no harm to his neighbor. So we need to respect love, and we don’t prohibit the free exercise of brotherly love. Brotherly love are those that do exercise moral principles. And we need to honor the Bible love, to do no harm to anyone, and punish those that do. The bottom line is, Bible morality saves lives, it saves medical cost, it saves marriages. Bible morality saves the life and the future of innocent children.

chunks.section_question: What does 2 Peter 1 teach about the solution?
chunks.short_answer: He says Second Peter chapter 1 gives the principles of a solution: admit we are wrong, repent, and change laws. He says whether you are a humanist or a Christian you have no excuse to harm others, so Americans must make the right judgment.
chunks.text: And I submit to you that Second Peter chapter 1 gives us the principles of a solution. We must admit we are wrong, we must repent from that wrong, and change laws that promote right. The naive and not-so-naive accept and promote harmful sexual behavior. They promote its lies and legalize its preventable diseases, deaths and monetary harm, and especially harm to innocent children. I’ve given you alarming forensic facts, and the Bible has given us a solution. Whether you are a humanist or whether you are a Christian, you have no excuse, no excuse to harm others. So, Americans, we presented to you the facts; now you must make the right judgment.

faqs.question: Which two STDs does he say existed before 1960?
How many STDs does he say can kill or are incurable?

faqs.question: What does he say came out of the closet after 1960?
faqs.answer: He lists sex shops, nude bars and adult theaters, public expression of homosexuality, divorce, abortion on demand and divorce on demand, and says being a virgin was no longer popular.

faqs.question: Does he say people are born homosexual?
faqs.answer: He says they were not born that way, that science said there is no homosexual gene and that it is a choice; the heartbreak, he says, is that people say they cannot change.

faqs.question: What does he say about “hope and change”?
faqs.answer: He says a political call for hope and change never admitted these judgments were wrong, and that it was not the Bible ideal of hope and change, which includes repentance.

faqs.question: Should the Bible be taught in public schools?
faqs.answer: He says we need to get the Bible back into public schools, teaching the principles of moral character.

faqs.question: What does he say about sex before marriage?
faqs.answer: He says to use patience to wait and marry one man to one woman for life, and to wait and save sex for marriage.

faqs.question: What if someone does not believe in God?
faqs.answer: He says whether you believe in God or not, you must believe in love, and love does no harm to his neighbor.

faqs.question: What does he ask Americans to do?
faqs.answer: He asks them to admit we are wrong, repent, change laws, and make the right judgment, because no one has an excuse to harm others.
